messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2637001234 created — high auth failure/spike detected from forwarder-prod-01 -> external S3 endpoint (logshipper). Auto-alert: suspicious PUTs with bearer tokens. https://internal/incidents/2637001234
alex (oncall): saw alert, investigating. grabbing logs from forwarder-prod-01
maria (sec): @alex @tj please preserve logs, do NOT restart pods until we snapshot. tagging sec-oncall.
alex (oncall): running: ```kubectl -n infra logs forwarder-prod-01 | grep 's3.amazonaws.com' | tail -n 50``` — seeing repeated PUT with header "Authorization: Bearer eyJ..." looks like token leak
tj (infra): isolating pod — cordoning node-3, scaling forwarder-frontend replicaset to 0 for that replica, applying temp egress deny for forwarder service CIDR
alex (oncall): applied NetworkPolicy block, leaving one replica for debug, snapshotting pv: `kubectl exec -it forwarder-prod-01 -- tar cz /var/log/forwarder | gzip > /tmp/forwarder_logs.tgz`
maria (sec): generate key rotation plan for any keys found in logs. @zoe start customer impact matrix — which customers used indexer-forwarder in last 24h?
zoe (cust-success): pulling list now, will DM PII-customer list. prelim: cust-alpha, cust-gamma may be impacted (writes observed)
maria (sec): legal loop in: @legal please advise on notification requirements; we may have leaked auth tokens to external buckets
legal: on it. need scope, timeline, and whether tokens were used to access customer objects. collect object list & evidence
alex (oncall): pulled sample log snippet: ```[2026-03-20T18:21:03Z] PUT https://s3.amazonaws.com/tenant-uploads/abcd.txt Authorization: Bearer XYZ123TOKEN``` — token appears valid for ~3600s
maria (sec): urgent: rotate API keys for forwarder service and any principals that used the token. Steps: 1) identify keys 2) revoke 3) issue new & update config store 4) audit for token use
tj (infra): started key rotation: `aws iam rotate-access-key --user forwarder-service` then updating secrets in vault. Will stagger rollout to avoid mass customer failures
zoe (cust-success): prepping customer comms draft. will wait for legal signoff before send. marking customers P1 if active writes in last 2h
alex (oncall): monitoring for replay attempts — WAF rules added to block suspicious UA and IP ranges 52.14.0.0/16
maria (sec): set incident severity to P1, standing up bridge in 10m. @pagerbot add runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/auth-leak
pagerbot: Bridge created: https://meet.link/incident-2637001234 participants: alex, maria, tj, zoe, legal
alex (oncall): taking lead for mitigation, handing over oncall to @sam after rotation finishes for overnight watch
sam (oncall-2): ack. will monitor token revocations & suspicious s3 GET/PUTs. posting hourly summaries :thumbsup:
maria (sec): follow-up tasks: postmortem owner = maria. Action items: improve redaction in forwarder logs, add egress allowlist, automated key rotation cadence
zoe (cust-success): will prepare initial customer notification template + affected customer list for legal review
legal: confirm we'll notify customers if tokens were used to access customer buckets. standing by for evidence & object list
alex (oncall): preserving logs at /mnt/snapshots/incident-2637001234, moving copies to forensics bucket (read-only)
maria (sec): thanks team. keep updates concise on this thread; use bridge for verbal coordination. if new suspicious activity, post here with 1-line summary and timestamp
